spoken_first_2s: आज अगर ₹5,000 नहीं कमाए तो यह ढाबा हमेशा

notes.hook: 'Aaj agar ₹5,000 nahi kamaye to yeh dhaba hamesha ke liye band'
notes.what_goes_wrong: A real stake and a number in the first line, but a stock 'garib dhaba' turnaround plot with a 10-second silent gap (28-38s); the hook can't save a story viewers have seen a hundred times (visuals unchecked).
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: stock rags-to-riches plots; a strong first-line stake still needs a story people haven't seen.
